question: Adam needed to climb ninety-six stair steps to reach the rooftop. He already climbed seventy-four. How many stair steps do left for Adam to climb now?
A chef used thirty-nine cherries to make a pie. Now he has fifty-eight cherries left. How many cherries did he have before he made the pie?
Winnie completed eighty-six consecutive repetitions for rope jumping yesterday. Today she completed only seventy-three. How many repetitions did she fell behind?
Gwen prepared ninety-eight books to sell in the flea market. After the activity ended she had ninety-six books left. How many did she sell?
A store has thirty-five shirts. If they sold thirty of them, how many shirts would they have?
Janet had eighty-five paper clips on the desk when she woke up in the morning. Before going to bed, she found there were twenty-six left. How many paper clips did she use today?
Olivia gave her cat two cheese cubes. Now Olivia has ninety-eight cheese cubes left. How many cheese cubes did Olivia have originally?
Amy had 2 dollars. If she got 13 more dollars for doing chores and 3 more for her birthday, how much money does she have now?
For lunch, 2 students selected chocolate milk, 15 selected strawberry milk and 3 selected regular milk. How many milks were taken total?
Roger had 2 new crayons, 4 used crayons and 8 broken crayons. How many crayons did Roger have total?
A chef was making soups. She made 2 bowls of chicken soup, 2 bowls of mushroom soup and 7 bowls of tomato soup. How many bowls of soup did she make total?
Henry bought 2 new fireworks and his friend bought 3. If they already had 6 saved from last year, how many do they have now?
At the bank, a customer turned in 2 dimes, 2 nickels and 7 quarters. What is the total number of coins the customer turned in?
During a sale, a shoe store sold 2 pairs of sneakers, 4 pairs of sandals and 11 pairs of boots. How many pairs of shoes did the store sell?
Amy was doing a classroom survey. She asked the girls in the class how many siblings they had and recorded the results: 1, 6, 10, 4, 3, 3, 11, 3 and 10. What is the mean of the results?
A car salesman sold 8 on Monday, 3 on Tuesday, 10 on Wednesday, 4 on Thursday, 4 on Friday and 4 on Saturday. What is the mean of the number of cars he sold?
A pet store had 13 siamese cats and 5 house cats. During a sale they sold 10 cats. How many cats do they have left?
Oliver had to wash 39 short sleeve shirts and 47 long sleeve shirts before school. If he had only washed 20 of them by the time school started, how many did he not wash?
Zoe bought two coloring books. One had 44 pictures and the other had 44. After one week she had already colored 20 of the pictures. How many pictures does she still have to color?
The school cafeteria ordered 25 red apples and 17 green apples for students lunches. But, if only 10 students wanted fruit, how many extra did the cafeteria end up with?
Matthew goes hiking every 12 days and swimming every 6 days. He did both kinds of exercise today. How many days from now will he go both hiking and swimming again?

A club has 16 girls and 8 boys as members. The president wants to break the club into groups, with each group containing the same combination of girls and boys. The president also wants to make sure that no one is left out. What is the greatest number of groups the president can make?

Sarah's Shipping and Ryan's Mail Services both ship packages. Sarah's trucks will only carry loads of 18 packages. In contrast, Ryan's trucks will only carry loads of 11 packages. If both businesses ended up shipping the same number of packages this morning, what is the minimum number of packages each must have shipped?

Two bikers are riding a circular path. The first rider completes a round in 12 minutes. The second rider completes a round in 18 minutes. If they both started at the same place and time and go in the same direction, after how many minutes will they meet again at the starting point?

The radio station gave away a $100 bill for every 100th caller. Every 30th caller received free concert tickets. How many callers must get through before one of them receives both a coupon and a concert ticket?
